title: A Wild Runner turns after its planned straight runway blocks

verification.actor: WILD species 234 (Stantler), acquired through spawn; live handle and attached presentation required
verification.trigger: Leave the same live Runner Stantler on neutral input until its two-tile planned straight runway blocks and it selects a clear perpendicular turn
verification.observable: The blocked planned straight request is ignored, the alternate eight-frame skid is accepted, and one six-frame post-skid recovery Walk commits in the new direction

setupMutations.change: Disposable test.sav, native Stantler spawn at map33 (586,404), and exact identity bind. Do not change the profile, terrain, input, policy state, direction choice, collision result, or motion during observation.

limits: Prepared spawning does not prove natural population spawning.
This proves one Route 29 blocked-runway turn window, not every terrain shape.
Registration alone is not runtime acceptance; the checked shared test must pass on the current ROM.

events.value: Spawn and bind Wild Stantler at map33 (586,404)
Keep input neutral and retain the blocked planned straight request, accepted turn skid, and accepted recovery Walk

stop.condition: The selected Stantler completes the turn skid and post-skid recovery

invariants: The planned two-tile straight corridor is rejected while its immediate tile remains the skid target
The alternate perpendicular turn reserves the skid tile and its first post-turn tile
The eight-frame skid and six-frame recovery each move one tile and commit exactly once
Movement Chain action and pause action stay zero
